facts.label: Perguntas no passivo
facts.sub: Singular: Was it painted? Plural: Were they sold? Resposta: Yes, it was. / No, they weren’t. Quem fez: by + pessoa.

facts.label: Foi…?
facts.sub: Para perguntar sobre uma coisa no passado, use Was + sujeito + particípio. Was this picture painted by hand? A resposta: Yes, it was. / No, it wasn’t.

facts.label: Foram…?
facts.sub: Para coisas no plural, use Were + sujeito + particípio. Were these colours mixed in the classroom? A resposta: Yes, they were. / No, they weren’t.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “Was the frame made by hand?” is a correct question.
We say “Did the frame made by hand?”
items.why: We say Was the frame made…?

items.s: “Yes, they were” answers a plural question.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “Was the frame made by hand?” is a correct question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Did the frame made by hand?” → Falso (We say Was the frame made…?)
“Yes, they were” answers a plural question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: An art fair in Sydney · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in the art room of a school in Sydney. The walls are full of colourful pictures. Elsa visits the school fair with her friend Dan. Dan studies there, so he knows the students. Elsa has a lot of questions about the pictures. She asks how each one was made.
“Dan, was this picture painted by hand?” says Elsa. “Yes, it was. It was painted by a student last year.” says Dan. “Were these colours mixed in the classroom?” says Elsa.
